article.headline: Goncalo Ramos clinches late winner as Erling Haaland limps off injured
article.summary: Goncalo Ramos scored a 79th-minute winner to secure a 2-1 Nations League victory for Portugal over Norway.
article.body:
Erling Haaland was substituted in the 67th minute after signaling to the bench during Sunday's Nations League clash in Porto. The Manchester City striker walked off the pitch nursing an apparent injury, raising immediate concerns for his club ahead of their upcoming match against Liverpool. The 26-year-old was replaced by Jorgen Strand Larsen with the scoreline deadlocked at 1-1.

The loss marks a third consecutive Nations League defeat for Norway, leaving their team struggling for form in Group A4. For Portugal, the victory ensures their place in the tournament's quarter-finals scheduled for March. The win reinforces their status as competition holders, maintaining a perfect record while navigating the high-profile absence of Cristiano Ronaldo, who left the national squad last week.

Norway took an early lead in the 36th minute through a Kristoffer Ajer half-volley from the edge of the box. Portugal responded just two minutes later when Joao Cancelo leveled the score with a powerful long-range strike. Goncalo Ramos eventually secured the result for the hosts in the 79th minute, stabbing home a Joao Felix lay-off. Portugal finished the match with 10 men after Francisco Conceicao received two quick yellow cards in the 87th minute for dissent.

Following the game, Portugal coach Jorge Jesus addressed the ongoing situation regarding Cristiano Ronaldo. Jesus stated that the forward's potential return to the national team remains his own choice, and that the parties could communicate before the next round of international call-ups.

article.headline: One-point field goal gives Roosters 19-18 grand final thriller over Knights
article.summary: The Sydney Roosters defeated the Newcastle Knights 19-18 in the 2026 NRL grand final, with Daly Cherry-Evans's field goal in the 70th minute proving decisive after the Roosters came back from 12-0 down.
article.body:
Daly Cherry-Evans's one-point field goal with ten minutes remaining separated the teams in a grand final that had 80,814 fans at Accor Stadium watching every moment until the final whistle. The Roosters trailed 12-0 at halftime after Newcastle scored twice against the run of play, including a spectacular 95-metre effort by Kalyn Ponga, but stormed back in the second half. Mark Nawaqanitawase scored twice for Sydney, with his second try coming after a lucky ricochet off the upright, while Billy Smith also crossed. Greg Marzhew's 77th-minute try for Newcastle set up a tense finish, but the Knights could not get into scoring range to level the match.

The victory gives Sydney their first premiership of 2026 after a dominant performance from their forward pack. Naufahu Whyte, the Roosters prop, ran 188 metres and made 78 post-contact metres, the most of any forward, while James Tedesco accumulated 385 running metres, a grand final record. Earlier the same day, the Roosters women won their third NRLW premiership, defeating Brisbane 30-6 in a rematch of the 2025 decider.

Cherry-Evans played his final NRL game in the grand final, sealing victory with his crucial field goal. The loss ended Newcastle's first grand final appearance in recent years, despite a spirited effort from their squad.

article.headline: Sydney Sweeney-backed Novig valuation surges to $2 billion after provocative campaign
article.summary: Actress Sydney Sweeney's controversial Novig sports trading campaign triggered a massive 94% increase in platform trading volume following its September launch.
article.body:
First-time depositors on the prediction market platform surged by more than 218% in the 20-day window surrounding the launch of Sydney Sweeney’s "Just Sports" advertising campaign. The actress, who took an equity stake in the company, appeared in the ads wearing sports attire that drew immediate, widespread debate regarding the representation of women in sports media. While the campaign sparked criticism from some columnists and athletes, co-founder Jacob Fortinsky reported that the influx of new users and activity far exceeded company expectations following the September 9 launch.

The rapid growth of the platform highlights the significant influence celebrity branding exerts on emerging fintech markets. As Novig competes against established prediction platforms, this marketing strategy effectively forced the company’s name into the mainstream, resulting in a valuation increase from $500 million to $2 billion within just a few months. For investors and market observers, the sudden growth confirms that the high-profile partnership served as a decisive catalyst for the platform’s expansion, despite the negative public reception from media critics.

CNBC reported that active users climbed 96% month-over-month in September, with total app downloads increasing by over 187%. Fortinsky noted that the success of the campaign, which occurred alongside the start of the NFL season, left the leadership team satisfied with the outcome. The company remains engaged in ongoing legal challenges against multiple states over its right to regulate sports event contracts independently of local oversight.

article.headline: Liam Lawson storms to seventh after best career start in Malaysia
article.summary: Liam Lawson surged from 11th to fourth on the opening lap before securing a seventh-place finish at the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia.
article.body:
On the opening lap, Liam Lawson surged from his 11th-place grid position all the way to fourth after a bold decision by Racing Bulls to start on intermediate tyres in wet conditions. By the first corner, the New Zealander was already alongside eventual race winner Max Verstappen in a direct fight for third place. "I had one of the best starts I’ve ever had in my career, and that put us in a great position for the rest of the race," Lawson said following the event.

This result marks Lawson’s 11th points finish of the 2026 season and provides a significant boost for Racing Bulls in their competitive battle against Alpine. Although Lawson gradually slipped back as faster cars navigated the field and track conditions shifted, the late-race retirement of George Russell and other incidents allowed the Kiwi to reclaim valuable positions. According to 1News, this strategy of capitalising on difficult track conditions has been a decisive factor in outscoring their rivals over the last two race weekends.

The race at the Sepang International Circuit proved chaotic, featuring safety cars, a nearly two-hour delay, and constant reshuffling of the pack. Lawson admitted he initially felt he deserved more than a ninth-place trajectory before luck in the final stages elevated him to seventh. He successfully defended his position through the closing laps despite persistent pressure from the McLaren drivers, ultimately crossing the line to collect another six championship points. With the season now entering its final stretch, Lawson’s ability to maximize points in unpredictable weather remains a key strength for the team as they look toward the remaining seven races.

article.headline: Isabelle Kelly captains Jillaroos squad as Tarryn Aiken replaces legend Ali Brigginshaw
article.summary: Coach Jess Skinner named a 23-player Australian squad for the 2026 Rugby League World Cup while omitting retiring icon Ali Brigginshaw.
article.body:
Sydney Roosters skipper Isabelle Kelly will lead her country for the first time as captain, heading a 23-player squad tasked with winning a fourth consecutive Rugby League World Cup. The selection process marked a significant shift in leadership, as coach Jess Skinner confirmed the difficult omission of 36-year-old veteran Ali Brigginshaw. The legendary halfback, who recently concluded her NRLW career following the Brisbane Broncos' grand final loss to the Roosters, was informed of the decision in a call that Skinner described as one of the hardest of her coaching career.

This roster announcement reflects a definitive changing of the guard within Australian women's rugby league. While Brigginshaw served the national jersey for over 17 years, the coaching staff opted for the current form of Tarryn Aiken. Aiken, who secured the Karyn Murphy Medal after a standout grand final performance, spearheaded the Roosters' 30-6 victory by scoring a try and contributing two assists. Her selection, alongside club teammate and debutant Jocelyn Kelleher, signals a transition in the halves pairing as Australia looks to maintain its international dominance.

The Sydney Roosters dominate the squad with eight representatives, while the Broncos contribute three players. Alongside Kelleher, Roosters teammate Sariah Paki and North Queensland Cowboys prop Makenzie Weale are set to make their international debuts. Wests Tigers back rower Shaylee Bent also earns a recall, returning to the setup for the first time since 2023. Retiring veteran Millie Elliott remains in the fold to provide experience for what is expected to be a final tournament appearance.

Australian Rugby League Commission Executive Chairman Peter V’landys confirmed that the group was chosen based on season-long consistency in the NRLW. The selected players are now preparing to carry on the legacy of the three previous Australian teams that successfully lifted the World Cup trophy.

article.summary: Costa Rica hosts Haiti this Sunday at Estadio Ricardo Saprissa to secure its position in the Concacaf Nations League Category A.
article.body:
Costa Rica faces a high-stakes showdown this Sunday at 6 p.m. at Estadio Ricardo Saprissa Aymá, with the national team fighting to retain its place in Category A of the Concacaf Nations League. The match marks the final game of the group stage, serving as a critical hurdle for interim coach Bryan Ruiz’s squad.

Securing a result is essential for Costa Rica to maintain its status within the top tier of regional competition. For Haiti, the stakes are equally significant, as the visiting side aims to capture the top spot in Group 1, a position that would grant them a path to face Panama in the next stage of the tournament.

Interim head coach Bryan Ruiz has made tactical adjustments to his roster to compensate for player injuries and the suspension of Jossimar, who is sidelined due to yellow card accumulation. Ruiz confirmed that Mayron George has been called up as a direct replacement for the attacking vacancy. Additionally, Anthony “Pikachu” Hernández returns to the fold after recovering from a previous injury, with Ruiz noting that Hernández is fully fit and capable of providing significant impact on the wing. Experienced left-back Ronald Matarrita also rejoins the selection, drawing praise from Ruiz for his consistent performance in his position during recent matches.

The defensive execution will be under scrutiny following previous matches where set-piece vulnerabilities proved costly. The match will be broadcast live across various platforms, including Teletica 7 and Canal 6 Repretel in Costa Rica, while viewers in the United States can follow the action via Fox Sports 2, TUDN, and FOX One. article.headline: Jaymie Graham clinches North Melbourne head coach role after Buckley withdraws bid
article.summary: Fremantle assistant coach Jaymie Graham has been appointed as the new North Melbourne head coach for the 2027 season.
article.body:
Jaymie Graham is set to take the reins at North Melbourne in 2027, securing the senior coaching role after a competitive selection process. The 43-year-old appointment comes immediately after former Collingwood coach Nathan Buckley formally withdrew his name from contention, clearing the path for Graham to finalize his presentation to the club board this Monday. Graham previously served as an assistant coach at Fremantle, where the team finished narrowly short of a premiership title this year.

This decision marks a significant turn for North Melbourne following the high-profile sacking of Alastair Clarkson, who was dismissed with one year remaining on his five-year contract. While the club managed only 20 victories across 81 games during Clarkson’s tenure, the 2026 campaign showed signs of progress with nine wins out of 23 games. Graham inherits a side viewed as having high potential, bolstered by deep talent and significant draft capital available at Arden Street.

Graham’s road to the top job included prior attempts at Carlton and Essendon, where he reached the final stages of selection but ultimately missed out to Josh Fraser and Mark McVeigh respectively. His coaching experience at the AFL level is not entirely new; he previously managed three games as a stand-in coach, including one stint at West Coast in 2018 and two matches at Fremantle in 2022. The appointment coincides with the official opening of the AFL trade period, signaling an immediate start to his duties in shaping the team's future roster. The club board was scheduled to ratify his appointment following a presentation on Monday.

article.headline: Lula Leads in 52 Nations as Flávio Bolsonaro Claims 33 Countries
article.summary: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva leads the presidential race among Brazilian voters living abroad across 85 countries with 156,889 total votes.
article.body:
Across 85 countries where voting results have been tallied, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has secured 156,889 votes compared to 143,533 for Flávio Bolsonaro. The electoral map shows a sharp divide: Lula finds his strongest support in European nations including Portugal, Germany, and France, while Bolsonaro maintains dominance in Japan, Israel, and Thailand. In the United States, which holds the largest concentration of Brazilian voters abroad with 265,437 people eligible to participate, Bolsonaro holds a significant lead with 45,004 votes against Lula's 23,335.

These results matter because they provide the first indication of electoral trends among the 918,876 Brazilian citizens registered to vote outside the country. While these overseas voters represent only 0.5% of the total Brazilian electorate of 158.7 million, their ballots are cast exclusively for the presidential seat, making them a crucial segment of the final tally. The competition between these two candidates highlights a polarized electorate as the official results are finalized by the Tribunal Superior Eleitoral (TSE).

According to Poder360 and G1, the voting process began in New Zealand, where polls opened 16 hours ahead of Brasília time. While G1 reported that Lula led in early ballot box counts across Asia and Europe, Poder360 noted that Bolsonaro's performance in the United States acted as a major counterweight to the lead the petista established in other regions. With urns placed in 186 cities across 134 countries, the logistics of this election span the globe.

The TSE began releasing official data following the conclusion of voting in Brasília. Further updates and the final consolidation of results for the presidential race will continue to emerge from the electoral authority.

article.summary: The Netherlands secured a 2-1 Nations League victory over Serbia in Eindhoven to climb to the top of Group A2.

Joshua Zirkzee’s decisive second-half tap-in ensured a 2-1 victory for the Netherlands, moving the team to the top of their UEFA Nations League group. The win was underscored by a milestone achievement for Virgil van Dijk, who marked his 100th international appearance for his country. The Manchester United forward, who entered the match at half-time, converted a Tijjani Reijnders pass to seal the result after Serbia had pushed hard to maintain parity.

This victory is vital for the Dutch squad as they look to distance themselves from a year defined by defensive inconsistencies. While head coach Xavi remains unbeaten through four matches, the team has navigated recent games seeking to shore up a backline that has struggled to prevent opposing goals throughout 2026. The result keeps the Netherlands in a commanding position in Group A2 with only two games remaining in the campaign.

According to the BBC and Flashscore, the scoring began just after the half-hour mark when Teun Koopmeiners whipped a free-kick into the bottom corner. Serbia responded four minutes later through Mihajlo Cvetkovic, who headed home his first international goal to level the match. Despite sustained pressure from the visitors, including efforts from Lazar Samardzic and Cvetkovic, the Dutch defense led by Van Dijk successfully repelled the Serbian attack to secure all three points.

The Netherlands will now focus on maintaining their momentum as they approach the final stages of the Nations League group phase, aiming to build on the tactical improvements established during this successful international window.

article.headline: Germany dominates possession but settles for frustrating goalless draw in Greece
article.summary: Germany played to a 0-0 stalemate against Greece in their Nations League match at Toumba Stadium.
article.body:
Germany controlled the ball with 70.1% possession and attempted 21 shots, yet failed to secure a victory during their Nations League trip to Thessaloniki. The visitors completed 640 passes compared to Greece's 267, but the team's lack of verticality in the final third left the scoreline deadlocked at 0-0. A first-half strike from Jonathan Burkhardt was ruled out by the video assistant referee following a handball by Tom Bischof, marking a frustrating end to the international window for new head coach Jurgen Klopp. Despite the territorial dominance, Germany tested the Greek goalkeeper only four times throughout the match.

The result leaves Germany third in Group A2, sitting three points behind leaders the Netherlands and unbeaten Greece. For Germany captain Florian Wirtz, the inability to convert pressure into a decisive goal was a source of frustration, though he noted the squad has only been together for a week. The match featured few clinical moments, with Greece also struggling to find the net despite early attempts from Fotis Ioannidis and later efforts by Konstantinos Mavropanos and Giorgos Masouras.

Under Jurgen Klopp's leadership, Germany has now managed one win from their opening four matches. The coach acknowledged the team's need for growth while defending his tactical decisions and player selections. Germany's defense remained largely untroubled, with goalkeeper Jonas Urbig making two saves to preserve the clean sheet, although defenders Malick Thiaw and others were cautioned for tactical challenges as the game progressed into a one-sided possession exercise. Germany currently holds third place in the group standings as they look ahead to future international fixtures.

article.headline: Indianapolis Colts Rout Washington Commanders 30-13 Amidst London Ticket Price Cuts
article.summary: The Indianapolis Colts defeated the Washington Commanders 30-13 in London after the NFL slashed ticket prices to boost attendance at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium.
article.body:
While the Indianapolis Colts secured a 30-13 victory over the Washington Commanders, the Sunday match at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium served as a stark indicator of shifting market conditions for the NFL in the UK. Despite an official UK fanbase of 18.6 million, the stadium crowd reached only 60,907, a figure that followed multiple rounds of ticket price reductions by the league. Fans noted a significant contrast in costs, with some spectators seated next to others who paid vastly different amounts for the same experience due to last-minute discounts. 

The price adjustments arrive as the league faces scrutiny from long-term supporters. Critics point out that the cheapest ticket prices have increased by 43.9% since 2019, far outpacing the 32.4% rate of UK inflation during the same period. For many, these costs, combined with the removal of season-ticket packages, have turned a premier sporting event into an inaccessible prospect, leading to unsold seats for upcoming fixtures. 

Despite the attendance challenges, the NFL maintains its international expansion strategy, with nine regular-season games played abroad during this 2026 season. The league has already hosted matches in Brazil and Australia, with upcoming games scheduled for France, Spain, Germany, and Mexico. Research from American Express estimates that the current trio of London games could generate £90m in economic activity, with visiting fans spending an average of £450 per person.

The London series continues as the Jacksonville Jaguars face the Philadelphia Eagles at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium. The final London match of the month is scheduled for 18 October at Wembley Stadium, where the Jacksonville Jaguars will play the Houston Texans.

article.headline: Flávio Bolsonaro tops first round as Brazil election heads to run-off
article.summary: Neither candidate secured 50% of the vote, forcing a presidential run-off scheduled for 25 October.
article.body:
With 99% of votes counted in Brazil's presidential race, right-wing challenger Flávio Bolsonaro emerged in the lead with 47.03% against incumbent President Lula da Silva's 45.16%. As Brazilian electoral law requires a candidate to exceed 50% of the vote to win outright, the result guarantees a decisive second round between the two candidates. Bolsonaro, the 45-year-old son of jailed former president Jair Bolsonaro, performed stronger than initial polling suggested, positioning himself as the frontrunner for the next stage of the contest.

The outcome of this election holds significant weight for Latin America's largest economy, which remains deeply polarized. The campaign has centered on critical issues including crime, corruption, national sovereignty, and the state of the economy. For the 80-year-old incumbent Lula, a victory would secure a fourth term for the veteran politician. Conversely, a win for Bolsonaro would align Brazil with a broader conservative shift seen across the region and among allies of the Trump administration, potentially impacting future international relations and trade security.

According to the BBC, Bolsonaro's Liberal Party also achieved notable success in legislative results, securing the majority of seats for governors, senators, and federal deputies, which promises the party considerable influence in Congress. The Guardian reports that voters are now turning their attention to the next phase of the campaign, as no other candidate reached a significant percentage of the vote in the first round. Both major candidates largely avoided traditional TV debates during the primary phase, leaving the electorate to weigh the polarized platforms of the two leading figures.

The final determination of the nation's leadership will take place on 25 October, when voters head back to the polls for the run-off election. This second vote will finalize whether the incumbent retains his seat or if the right-wing opposition successfully takes control of the presidency.

The result leaves Craig Bellamy’s side with a third defeat in four Nations League fixtures, following a week where they also secured a win against Norway. The match hinged on a decisive second-half error when Wales goalkeeper Danny Ward gifted the ball to Gustav Isaksen inside the penalty area before fouling the forward to concede the spot-kick. Despite maintaining 54 per cent possession in the first half, the Welsh side struggled to break down the Danish defense and managed only a single shot on target throughout the entire match. For Denmark, the victory was achieved despite losing captain Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg to injury within the opening 10 minutes of play. Craig Bellamy’s team now faces the task of regrouping after failing to convert their periods of possession into significant attacking threats, with Brennan Johnson and Ethan Ampadu both failing to capitalize on limited opportunities during the contest. The loss marks a setback for Wales as they navigate a challenging Nations League campaign, while Denmark’s efficient performance ensures they maintain their momentum in Group A4. Bellamy opted for continuity in his starting lineup, making only one change from the side that defeated Norway, but the squad ultimately could not replicate the attacking sharpness required to overcome the Danish backline. The result reflects a clinical display from the visitors, who punished a rare defensive lapse to leave the Cardiff City Stadium with all three points.
